speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In this term of Government, the Ministry of National Development (MND) will continue the work to make our city and our homes more green, liveable, and sustainable, in order to support the diverse aspirations of Singaporeans today and in the future.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: But we recognise that COVID-19 has significantly impacted our lives and our livelihoods as well as the way we live, work, and play.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Some of these changes are short-term, while others may be permanent structural shifts.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Most importantly, we seek to be responsive and agile in tackling these challenges together.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The construction sector has been hit hard by COVID-19.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Government agencies have been working hard to help construction and renovation firms restart.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We have also provided significant financial support to help our firms tide over this difficult period.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This will help preserve industry capacity for us to continue building and improving Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This includes adopting advanced building technologies to allow for cleaner, higher quality, and less manpower-intensive construction.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will drive research, innovation, and digitalisation across the built environment value chain, from construction to property transactions services and facilities management.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also enhance professionalism at all levels across the sector, to create new and better jobs for Singaporeans, guided by a comprehensive Skills Framework.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will grow local construction and consultancy firms to be industry leaders, which will not only serve Singapore's own needs, but also to seize opportunities overseas.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Amid the COVID-19 crisis, we will continue to take care of Singaporeans' housing needs.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We are also working hard to ensure that construction projects can resume smoothly, to minimise delays in the completion of our Build-To-Order (BTO) flats.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: These delays have impacted families who have been waiting for their new homes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also monitor the housing market closely and take measures where needed to keep it stable and sustainable.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will ensure that public housing remains accessible and affordable, especially for young families seeking to own their first home.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will need to keep flats affordable as we inject more public housing in and around the city centre.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This will ensure that our public housing estates remain inclusive and vibrant places where residents of different backgrounds can mix and interact.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In line with our efforts to keep public housing inclusive, we will continue to cater to the diverse housing needs of different Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For our seniors, we have expanded and enhanced our schemes to help them tap on their flat's value to supplement their retirement adequacy.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For lower income families, we will continue to support them to buy their own flats.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For those who are unable to afford home ownership, we will continue to provide highly subsidised public rental housing that is well-integrated with home ownership flats in good living environments.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We also regularly review our housing plans and policies to better support various groups of Singaporeans with their housing needs, including multigenerational families, singles, and single parents.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In addition, we will continue to rejuvenate our towns and keep public housing highly liveable, through various upgrading programmes.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will also continue developing our plans to progressively redevelop older HDB towns to keep them vibrant, through the Voluntary Early Redevelopment Scheme.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This will be a major and complex undertaking.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We aim to develop "Healthy Towns for all ages", by planning and designing our HDB towns and estates to better support the physical, social and mental well-being of residents at different life stages.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: As part of the SG Together movement, we will also broaden and deepen community engagement, by involving residents to contribute ideas, as well as to jointly create plans to refresh and enliven community spaces.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Through shared neighbourhoods, public spaces, and experiences, Singaporeans can build stronger bonds and a more united community.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: A City in Nature, a Greener Urban Environment We remain committed to our greening efforts island-wide, to transform Singapore into a City in Nature over the next decade.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will dedicate more nature parks for recreational activities, and protect our nature reserves from the impact of urbanisation.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will conserve more native flora and fauna, introduce more natural landscapes and waterbodies in our gardens and parks, and integrate nature into our urban areas and pathways.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: By extending and enhancing our natural capital in this manner, Singaporeans will enjoy a higher quality living environment, and have greater access to the benefits of nature on our health and well-being.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Our urban infrastructure will become greener too, as part of our climate change efforts.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We are working with the industry and community to roll out the next Green Building Masterplan and raise building sustainability standards.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: At the town level, we will design new HDB towns for greater environmental sustainability, with plenty of green spaces.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: For instance, Tengah will have a comprehensive cycling network with dedicated cycling paths on both sides of all roads.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: It will also feature the first "car-free" HDB town centre where roads will run underground to free up the surface level for people.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We invite every Singaporean to join us in shaping the future of our city and our home.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Earlier this year, we launched our One Million Trees movement with the support of community partners to engage Singaporeans from all walks of life to be stewards of our island's greenery.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan, gazetted last year, was the product of extensive public engagement.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to partner the community and industry, as we push ahead to lay the groundwork for major projects.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This includes revitalising communities along the Rail Corridor, by working with stakeholders to celebrate the heritage of these areas and to introduce new amenities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We are rejuvenating our Central Business District to ensure that it remains vibrant and relevant, while bringing jobs closer to homes, through growth centres like JLD and Punggol Digital District.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Longer-term projects, such as development of the Greater Southern Waterfront and redevelopment of the Paya Lebar Airbase site, will provide future generations more opportunities and new ways to live, work and play.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Each generation builds upon the efforts of the previous one.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will work with Singaporeans to build a better home for our generation as well as future generations of Singaporeans.
